about_the_game:
In the summer of 2026, strange glitches started appearing across the world. At first, people treated thought it was funny, posting videos online despite government warnings. Suddenly a time incident happened. Portals opened, timelines mixed, and wars started across eras. Cavemen, knights, soldiers, and machines clashed in what many now call The Chrono Flux.

You play as a student who built a machine capable of switching time eras. Trying to solve this mystery, and restoring balance.

Gameplay
Chrono Flux is a rogue-like top-down shooter where each run plunges you into procedurally generated dungeons drawn from colliding time eras. Players can equip two eras at once and switch between them mid-combat, altering visuals, music, mechanics, and even enemy behavior.

Features

  • Era Switching - Equip two timelines per run and switch between them.

  • Glitched Enemies - Enemies in the wrong era gain buffs.

  • Procedural Dungeons - Explore rooms filled with enemies, loot, traps, and bosses.

  • Weapons & Passives - Collect scimitars, crossbows, laser guns, and strange items that stack into unique builds.

  • Dynamic Audio & Art - Pixel art and music change with every era.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM)2 Quad 2.7 Ghz, AMD Phenom(TM)II X4 3 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 260, Radeon HD 5770, 1024 MB, Shader Model 3.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Chrono Flux is a rogue-like top down shooter with time switching mechanics. Equip two eras per run and switch mid combat to your advantage. Enemies outside their timeline become glitched and stronger as you fight enemies, and bosses in a procedurally generated dungeons.
